set.t: Des Moines Register 31 Oct 1909: home 2 mi NW of Palmyra, about 10 mi NE of Indianola; 100 acres with ten or a dozen outbuildings. The gold was dug by court order from under a small, always-padlocked outbuilding (the old shed or smokehouse about 30 yards north of the house). He died promising to show "lots and lots of money" the next day, and neighbours believed more was buried; no second find or heirs' sale was reported. Placed from a 1930s air photo: search the old outbuilding sites around the farmstead. Occupied farm: permission only.

src: Daily Gate City, 20 Sep 1909, and Oskaloosa Herald, 23 Sep 1909 (Indianola dispatch; same wire text; LoC)
